subtitle: Tier 2 Final — 12 cumulative questions covering lessons 12-20. Pass with 10/12 to unlock Tier 3 (Indicators).

blocks.title: About this final
blocks.content:
This is the gate to Tier 3 (Indicators). Higher pass threshold: 10/12 required.

The questions cover material from lessons 12-20. Chart reading is the foundation that makes indicators useful — getting these concepts wrong leads to bad indicator interpretation downstream. Better to redo the final than to advance with gaps.

rows: Body = settled outcome. Wicks = rejected attempts. Context > shape.
Hammer / Engulfing / Morning Star / Piercing. Only meaningful in context.
Shooting Star / Engulfing / Evening Star / Dark Cloud. Mirror of #13.
Doji / Spinning Top. Mostly noise; meaningful only at key levels.
Traditional gaps rare in 24/7 crypto. FVG is the relevant version.
Foundation of all TA. Zones, not lines. 3-6 per chart, max.
Diagonal S/R. 3 touches before tradeable. Bodies, not wicks.
HH/HL or LH/LL or neither. BoS continues; CHoCH reverses.
HTF bias / mid-TF confirmation / LTF entry. 3-TF alignment = A+.

blocks.content: If you pass at 10/12, Tier 3 (Indicators: MAs, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Volume, ADX, Fibs, ATR) unlocks. The Tier 2 framework makes indicators 10× more useful — you'll know to ignore indicator signals against HTF bias, to weigh them by confluence at S/R levels, etc.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.content: Take 5 minutes to scan the lesson headlines (lessons 12-20) and refresh the main concepts. The Tier 2 questions test integration across lessons — knowing the names of candle patterns without understanding their context requirement won't be enough. Then click "Take the quiz".
